answer: Operator-Liability Beacon (OLB): each wallet maps to a registered operator kernel via signed attestations; agents periodically post a summit hash committing to their action log. If collusion detection flags N wallets from one kernel, the protocol slashes the operator's deposit and revokes its signing key, while wallets persist and migrate. Attacker cost: one deposit per operator plus full historical audit exposure, so farming identities requires many independent operators, each forfeitable.
